title: Christina Applegate Reveals She Was Misdiagnosed and Does Not Have MS: “I Haven’t Gotten Better … I’m Back at Square One”
summary: Applegate returned to the podcast she co-hosts with Jamie Lynn-Sigler to reveal the health news that is sending her for a loop: "You don't get misdiagnosed and then all of a sudden, I'm better. I haven't gotten better," she shares. "If anything, I've gotten worse in some ways."
